description: This file defines the EntityPermissionsRouteProvider class, which provides routing for entity permissions forms in Drupal, specifically for entity types that are bundles of other entity types.

classes.name: EntityPermissionsRouteProvider
classes.description: Provides routes for entity permissions forms, mainly for entity types that are bundles of other entity types, in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the route provider with the entity type manager.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the route provider using the container and entity type.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Generates route collection for the given entity type, adding permissions form route if applicable.

methods.name: getEntityPermissionsRoute
methods.description: Builds the route for the entity permissions form if the entity type supports it and is a bundle of other types.
